components.name: Ink Button

components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; max-width: 360px; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(10 10 10 / 0.08), 0 18px 32px -22px rgb(10 10 10 / 0.45); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-card-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: var(--field-deep, #d6dade); } .ds-card-bar { position: relative; z-index: 1; justify-self: start; height: 34px; margin: -17px 0 0 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: var(--cat-salan, #ff6b1a); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-body { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem 1.5rem; } .ds-card-body h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.3125rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-card-urdu { margin: 0; justify-self: start; font-family: 'Nastaliq Names', 'Noto Nastaliq Urdu', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--ink-soft, #3d4248); } .ds-card-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #3d4248); }

components.name: Category Bars
components.description: Signature filter: each fill drawn to count over the largest count; the chosen bar wipes to full width with an ink down arrow tab, the others drop to a full colour strip at their own length.
components.css: .ds-bars { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--field, #e6e9ec); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bar { --fill: max(3.5rem, var(--len)); position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 0 0 1rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); text-align: left; isolation: isolate; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--cat); clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--fill)) 0 0); transition: clip-path 460ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-bar::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 2px; background: var(--field-deep, #d6dade); z-index: -2; } .ds-lab { font-weight: 850; font-size: 1.3125rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-lab small { margin-left: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar:hover .ds-fill { clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--fill) - 1.5rem) 0 0); } .ds-bar[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-fill { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } .has-choice .ds-bar[aria-pressed='false'] .ds-fill { clip-path: inset(74% calc(100% - var(--fill)) 0 0); } .ds-bar-tab { display: grid; place-items: center; align-self: stretch; width: 3.5rem; background: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--panel, #fff); } .ds-bar:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-bar:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Method Steps

components.css: .ds-steps { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0; padding: 1rem; list-style: none; background: var(--field, #e6e9ec); } .ds-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; width: 100%; padding: 1rem; border: 0; background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); text-align: left; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.3125rem; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-step:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel, #fff) 70%, var(--field, #e6e9ec)); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-n { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; background: var(--cat-salan, #ff6b1a); color: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); font-weight: 900; } .ds-text { background: linear-gradient(var(--ink, #0a0a0a), var(--ink, #0a0a0a)) no-repeat 0 56% / 0% 0.14em; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; transition: background-size 420ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), color 200ms ease; } .ds-step[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-text { background-size: 100% 0.14em; color: var(--ink-soft, #3d4248); } .ds-step[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-n { background: var(--ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--panel, #fff); }

narrative.overview:
A loud modular identity in the Studio Dumbar manner, put to a quiet job. Five flat colour bars, one per kind of dish, do the sorting: the cook finds tonight's dish by colour, then cooks from a page that stays calm, white and black. Everything else is cool grey field, white panel and near black ink, set square, flat and heavy. The colour is loud precisely because it is rationed to one meaning.

Type is a single tight grotesk run from 400 for reading to 900 for display, with dish words sitting on their category bar and Urdu dish names in Nastaliq beside them. Corners are square everywhere. Depth is tonal: panels sit on the field, bars sit on edges and seams. Motion is a wipe, never a bounce: bars clip in from the left, a done step is struck by an ink bar that wipes across each line.

Density is generous and kitchen sized: 18px body, 21px method steps, 44 to 52px targets, and a fixed cooking bar on phones. The system refuses the white food blog grid with a pastel hero.
keyCharacteristics: Five category colours, each meaning one kind of dish and nothing else.
Ink for every general action and every state change.
Bars live on the grey, on seams and on photo edges, never across the food.
Square corners, flat surfaces, one soft lift for hover and the welcome back banner.
One grotesk from 400 to 900, plus Nastaliq for Urdu dish names.
Authored 24px icon set, 2px square capped strokes.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: A category colour means its category and nothing else. General actions are ink. If a button would work the same on any recipe, it is not allowed a category colour.

rules.name: The Ink On Bar Rule
rules.body: Text on a bar is always ink. Never white on yellow, cyan, green, orange or magenta.

rules.name: The Dry Food Rule
rules.body: Bars never cross the food. Card bars are label wide and sit on the seam, half on the photo and half on the panel. Photo bars straddle the bottom edge by 12px. Only the small tilted ink square may sit on the food side.

rules.name: The Word On The Bar Rule
rules.body: In a dish title the category word sits on its colour bar (clone decoration, so it breaks cleanly across lines); the rest of the title stays bare ink on grey.

rules.name: The Steady Figures Rule
rules.body: Figures that change in place (amounts, servings, progress, counts) are tabular so nothing jumps; other figures are lining.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels rest flat. A shadow appears only for hover on a card or for the one banner that needs to float.

dos: Do give each kind of dish exactly one colour and use it only where that dish or category is named: title word bar, step tiles, card seam bar, photo corner bar, the home "Cook this" button.
Do keep every general action and every done state ink.
Do put text on a bar in ink, always.
Do place bars on seams and edges: card bars half on photo, half on panel; photo bars straddling the bottom edge by 12px.
Do draw category bars to count over the largest count, never shorter than the label.
Do keep corners square and borders 2px ink on anything pressable or typable.
Do use the authored 24px icon set with 2px square capped strokes for every icon.
Do pair dish and category names with their Urdu name in Nastaliq.
Do keep targets at 44px or more, and 52px for primary actions and inputs.
Do honour reduced motion: wipes and transitions collapse to instant.
donts: Don't use a category colour on a general action (servings stepper, resume, newsletter, filters).
Don't run a bar across the food; only the small tilted ink square may sit on the photo.
Don't set white text on a category bar.
Don't round corners or use pill shapes.
Don't add shadows beyond the single lift.
Don't use a second red; errors are fix-it red on grey or white and fix-it pink on ink.
Don't use icon fonts, emoji or text glyphs as icons.
Don't add a second Latin typeface.
